plain: A podcast host named Jesse Michels says he first learned of a book called VALIS from Jacques Vallée, a well-known researcher of UFOs. Michels says that while he was at Vallée's apartment, Vallée showed him the book and told him it was his favorite. He tells it during a conversation about UFOs, meaningful coincidences and prophetic dreams.
